links.outcome: Self-efficacy change in generative AI skills after an 8-week hospital workforce AI training program
links.effect: Large self-efficacy gains (MCP d=1.57; overall effect r=.574); satisfaction 4.03/5; job-specific competency stayed below the scale midpoint (knowledge-practice gap). Single-group pre-post, no comparator.
links.quote: This program suggests that transforming a multidisciplinary hospital workforce into AI-capable professionals is achievable through intensive, hands-on training centered on agent-level technologies, and that capstone projects with dedicated mentoring can serve as a pathway from classroom learning toward institutional AI adoption.

unlisted_practices: Capstone projects with dedicated team mentoring as a pathway from AI training to institutional adoption
Funded AI tool subscriptions and an internal cloud platform for hands-on staff AI training

screen.reason: Empirical pre-post evaluation measuring the effect of an intensive staff training program on hospital workforce AI competency and tool adoption.

primary.practice: multidisciplinary hospital staff AI training program
